sloka: तदद्भुतं स्थैर्यमवेक्ष्य राघवे समं जनो हर्षमवाप दु:खित: ।न यात्ययोध्यामिति दु:खितो ऽभवत् स्थिरप्रतिज्ञत्वमवेक्ष्य हर्षित: ॥ २.१०६.३४॥
transliteration: tadadbhutaṁ sthairyamavekṣya rāghave samaṁ jano harṣamavāpa du:khita: ।na yātyayodhyāmiti du:khito 'bhavat sthirapratijñatvamavekṣya harṣita: ॥ 2.106.34॥

translations.english: Having seen the wonderful deternmination of Rama, people were, at once, anguished and delighted, anguished because he would not return to Ayodhya, and delighted because he was firm in his resolve.
